claim: Patchline ships a confirmatory pre-registered trial with a frozen analysis plan and sealed hypotheses. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the confirmatory pre-registration claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make confirmatory-preregistration-gate`.
